title: Standard of conduct
bodyText: . A vendor issued a limited lines license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters.
bodyHtml: [§431:31-109]  Standard of conduct.  A vendor issued a limited lines license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters. [L 2021, c 110, §4]
